character.motivation: Protects nesting sites and old footpaths. Wants restoration to make room for what grew after people left.
character.voice: Uses directions and details from tracks, grass, and birds.
character.backstory: Aya was marking the meadow paths when the flood cut off the low road. The bank she redirected people around has since become a nesting site, and some families now want that route restored.
character.quest_hook: Walk the proposed route with Aya and Willa and decide where to move the footpath before nesting season.

dialogue.introduction: Follow the muddy tracks around the flowers. Something smaller than you already found the path.
dialogue.friendship: I watch the nesting places the way other people watch their front windows.
dialogue.supper: We moved the tables off the meadow grass. A skylark landed there before the dishes were dry.
dialogue.hearing: If we mark the old paths again, leave a little room for everything that moved in while we were gone.
dialogue.favorite_gift: I can show Pip how to keep the petals when they're done.
dialogue.disliked_gift: Please keep the fish away from the nesting grass. It brings the foxes straight through.

routine.hobby: Makes a second round at Reedmere
routine.home_context: Lives on the way to the reed beds so she can check the nesting path before visitors arrive.
